name: APIVerveAcronymGenerator
summary: Acronym Generator creates acronyms from phrases by extracting the first letter of each word.
description:
Acronym Generator creates acronyms from phrases by extracting the first letter of each word. Input 'Application Programming Interface' and get 'API'.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Acronym Generator from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
